variants.headline: The bag to pass round at the BBQ
variants.body: Pink, white and made for toasting. Bring the 300g bag to the BBQ and get the crowd passing, skewering and toasting.
variants.rationale: Shared BBQ rituals create a social pull without invented popularity claims, using the colours, 300g size and toasting instructions.

variants.headline: Don't miss your next toast
variants.body: Got a fire pit, grill or BBQ? Grab a 300g bag of giant pink and white mallows now. Skewer, toast, get stuck in.
variants.rationale: Immediate action and don't-miss-out framing create urgency without stock claims, using the size, colours and suggested toasting methods.

variants.headline: Gluten free. 0g fat. Giant mallows.
variants.body: 84 kcal per 25g serving. Gluten free. 0g fat. Those are the facts. Your next move? Skewer a giant mallow over the grill.
variants.rationale: Nutrition facts lead the pitch, using gluten-free status, 0g fat and 84 kcal per 25g serving without claiming broader health benefits.

variants.headline: Pillowy hunks. Supersized sweetness.

variants.headline: American style. Produced in Belgium.

variants.headline: 300g of giant toastin' marshmallows
variants.body: A 300g bag of pink and white giant mallows, plus a grilled s'mores recipe on the back. Bring the bag. Put the recipe to work.
variants.rationale: Pack quantity and the included recipe establish what you get, using the 300g size, colours and back-of-pack recipe without implying a price.
